description: Optional automated dependency updates (ADR-022). This file is inert until a Renovate runner is connected — the Mend-hosted app on GitHub, a scheduled CI job running the renovate container on GitLab/self-hosted. Renovate is chosen over platform-locked bots because the same config works on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, and self-hosted.
